breakdown.description: The prompt sets the support slopes to zero under symmetric loading, but a simply supported beam under uniform load still rotates at the supports.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the error by stating 'Set end slopes to zero at both supports due to symmetric loading.' This directly mirrors the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth removes this constraint entirely, recognizing that a simply supported beam under uniform load has non-zero slopes at the supports. The agent failed to correct this inconsistency.
